why_this_exists: A keyless, offline vertical slice: real public SEC filing metadata drives the Today cards; the account, quantities and Theses are synthetic and labelled. Nothing here is Owner data, and no model or network call is made at runtime.

rights.sec_metadata: SEC EDGAR public filing metadata; no document body, no news text.
rights.synthetic_scope: Fictional account/quantities authored for this demo.
rights.synthetic_thesis: Fictional investment logic, labelled SYNTHETIC in every record.

core_drivers: 铁路运量温和复苏、定价能力维持，资本开支高峰已过。
key_assumptions: 运量同比不再下滑，每单位收入同比正增长。
营业比率维持在 60% 附近，燃料成本可转嫁。
execution_risks: 劳工协议谈判与监管审查可能推迟运量恢复。
invalidation_conditions: 营业比率连续两个季度明显恶化，或运量再次转负。

core_drivers: 杂货零售的客流稳定与自有品牌渗透率提升。
key_assumptions: 同店销售保持正增长，毛利率不因促销而持续下滑。
execution_risks: 人工与物流成本上升压缩经营利润率。
invalidation_conditions: 同店销售转负且毛利率同步下滑。

thesis_note: DOW deliberately has no Thesis, so the slice can show an explicit THESIS_NOT_AVAILABLE instead of inventing one.

marks._note: SYNTHETIC price marks, not quotes. They exist so research has a price premise and What-if has a reference; they are not market data.
